correctness.rationale: Linearized Fourier eigenvalues yield rc=1+2/(1+u) and a transverse simple critical m=±1 pair; other three eigenvalues remain inside unit disk. Quadratic B map, zero cubic derivative, and h11/h20 nonresonant homological corrections produce exact cubic radial coefficient -(u+3)^2 P/(2(1+u)^2 Q). Independent SymPy substitution verified symbolic coefficient identity, cubic sign brackets and positive roots 0.606103247 and 1.270962528. Descartes plus sign alternation ensures exactly two positive roots, not merely observed roots. Strong resonances u=1/3,1 and zeros of P excluded; theorem only local. A pole/denominator and clipping-inactive arguments were checked.

General disordered logistic systems show instability but the full primary appendix was inaccessible, so retain possible coverage risk rather than disqualifying solely for access.
